article: Week1 Rank19 - creative pongal wishes in tamil
workflow: Higgsfield MCP nano_banana_pro with CDN product reference medias.
notes: Hero Shubhlatika Mangalsutra. Flatlay Chevalier Gold Chain. Lifestyle Ursa Hoop Earrings. Fair-skinned Indians for people slots.

higgsfield.theme_anchor: High-end commercial jewellery photography, hyper-realistic, HD quality, no distortion of jewellery, identical scale and design, macro-level detail, physically accurate details, natural textures only, no stylization, no illustration. Soft natural window light, warm daylight color temperature, realistic soft shadows, proper shallow depth of field. Shot on high-end DSLR, cinematic realism, 4K resolution, widescreen 16:9 landscape with full frame composition and safe margins. Entire subjects and jewellery fully visible, nothing cropped at frame edges.
higgsfield.negative_prompt: illustration, CGI look, cartoon, fantasy style, over-stylized, plastic glass, fake diamonds, fake gemstones, artificial lighting, studio HDR glow, unreal reflections, blurry jewellery, noise, low detail, AI artifacts, painting, digital art, unreal scale, oversized jewellery, distorted hands, extra fingers, extra bracelets, extra rings, product shot on plain background, cropped faces, cut-off heads, cut-off jewellery, out of frame, readable text, logos, giant rings, exaggerated proportions, dark skin, deep brown skin, heavily tanned skin

hero.prompt:
Casting (required): fair-skinned Indian woman only. Light wheatish to fair North Indian / urban Indian complexion. Do not use deep brown, dark, or heavily tanned skin.

Pongal 2027 warm harvest celebration hero. A close-up lifestyle photograph of a smiling fair-skinned Indian woman in a soft festive saree at home near a sunny window, holding a small bowl of sweet Pongal with soft steam. She wears the identical mangalsutra necklace shown in the reference images (@img1, @img2, @img3, @img4) naturally around her neck. The Shubhlatika Mangalsutra Necklace must be in sharp focus, 100% accurate, identical in chain, black bead stations, pendant design and proportions, with zero distortion, rendered at natural product scale, nested into the saree neckline with soft contact shadows. Soft morning window light. This mangalsutra is the single and only piece of jewelry in the entire image. No floating overlays, cutouts, or giant product diagrams. Keep the design of these jewelries accurate and do not change it's design. Jewelleries in focus. Hyperrealistic jewelry photography image. Position the jewelries naturally. Avoid: any other jewelry, extra necklaces, extra rings, extra bracelets, distorted hands, floating overlays, graphic drawings, cutouts, product diagrams, oversized jewelry, dark skin. Do not distort or hallucinate the jewelries.
hero.alt: Pongal 2027 hero featuring The Shubhlatika Mangalsutra Necklace

Keep the design of these jewelries accurate and do not change it's design. Jewelleries in focus. Hyperrealistic jewelry photography image.
